accessBasis.gate: CreateAccessService.resolveRegisterCreateAccess(VoucherRegisterType.payment) — the voucher_creation_mobile feature, then the Payments register create permission. Payments settings live in a SettingsScope.company category, so they are admin-only.

behaviourReviewed: The standalone payment form has NO bill-allocation control; the widget tree is voucher number, party header, amount, tax/discount, date, notes, bank list.
BankSelectionList is instantiated WITHOUT showUpiQrAction, so no UPI action renders on a payment (deliberate: money out).
Save is disabled until a bank ledger is selected.

Purchase invoice detail's _PaymentStatusBottomSheet (Update Payment Status) is the real payment-against-a-bill path: it asks which bank/cash ledger paid whenever the paid amount increases, and ABORTS the status update if the payment insert fails, showing 'Payment status was left unchanged.'
Settings → Payments & reminders → Money in & out holds Bank accounts and the UPI QR on unpaid invoices switch, which stays inert until a bank account carries a UPI ID.
inventoryDeviations: The inventory cell for record-payment says 'Supplier payment, bill allocation, bank/cash selection'. There is no bill-allocation picker on create_payment_screen.dart — payments recorded there are against the party, not a bill. The guide says so plainly and routes bill-level payment to the purchase invoice's Update Payment Status sheet, which is where the app actually links a payment to a bill.

settings/payments_settings_screen.dart is named in the inventory; it holds bank accounts and the UPI QR switch rather than any payment-entry setting, so it is covered under 'Bank or cash' and the collection-entitlement section.

visibilityBlocked.surface: Submit for approval / Resubmit for approval / Approve and save save-modes in create_payment_screen.dart
visibilityBlocked.reason: Gated on voucher_approvals, is_customer_visible = false in prod evidence. No public procedure or label written.

deliberatelyOmitted: Any statement that collection features come with the ability to record money, or the reverse — the guide separates them explicitly as instructed.
